criteria.text: Starting a new run from a linked checkout starts its story chat even when an old layout registry points at another linked checkout of the same clone, contains an old run intent, and Herdr lists that old workspace without worktree metadata.

Starting or reopening uses the unique live run workspace for the assigned checkout and clone, and the area tab with the matching name in that workspace, also when a `cd` in the shell startup file put its shell in another folder; retrying an allocation adopts Herdr's verified "already_open" result without creating duplicates.

An existing non-linked workspace of this clone can serve as the parent, including one the person opened; other clones, ambiguous run matches and changed checkout identities cannot supply the run's workspace.
PDD neither reads nor changes its old layout registry; "pdd workflow status --all" discovers clones only through the run index.
Existing unrelated workspaces, labels, native sessions and Git checkouts stay intact. Cleanup preserves adopted parents and refuses to close a run with changed roots, extra tabs or extra panes.

When PDD creates a repository parent with no Git identity, it saves the actual workspace and original root before attaching the verified clone path. A retry reuses that same workspace after checking its root. An uncertain create never authorizes a duplicate, and an unrelated blank workspace is never adopted by label.

given.registry: old linked source, old run intent
given.caller: different linked checkout of same clone

given.live: one run workspace at assigned cwd with same repo_key and linked kind, one area tab with single matching cwd pane
verified run; the shell of its story tab moved to another folder (a shell startup cd)
person-opened non-linked parent at verified primary with same repo_key
same repository name but different commonDir
two workspaces at assigned cwd with same repo_key and linked kind

given.savedWorkspace: live checkout_path or repo_key contradicts assignment; no unique valid run match

given.live: verified unique run and area tab

given.runs: one readable status in each clone

given.run: changed root terminal OR extra tab OR split pane

given.createReply: workspace ID and original root saved; worktree is null
given.retry: attach reply may be lost; exact root and live identity are checked

given.createEffect: new null-metadata row appears but acknowledgement is lost
given.saved: create intent and pre-create workspace IDs
